On-site release totals from tri_release_qty by doc_ctrl_num: Ammonia (doc 1323222323469) = AIR STACK 5120.9 lb (all other media NA) = 5120.9 lb; Mercury compounds (doc 1323222323471) = AIR FUG 0 + AIR STACK 0.4 + WATER 0 = 0.4 lb; Lead compounds (doc 1323222323596) = AIR FUG 0.1 + AIR STACK 0.8 + WATER 0.16 = 1.06 lb; Nitrate compounds (doc 1323222323584) = all media NA = 0 lb. Total on-site releases = 5120.9 + 0.4 + 1.06 + 0 = 5122.36 lb. Population (Richmond County, ACS 2020–2024 5-year, B01003) = 494,956.
